name: Konna Musume-tachi ni Omoikkiri Shasei Shitai -Aru Bishoujo Senshi-tachi no Hentai Ganbou-
original_name: こんな娘達におもいっきり射精したい -ある美少女戦士達の変態願望-
source:
They're beautiful. Those 5 pretty soldier heroines who save our world from looming darkness!
Yet, so few people know about those who supprot their existence ...
Rare fans of these unnoticeable girls create blogs and try to promote these less-represented heroines' daily lives and share their interests...
But the world is unsympathetic. "Other magical girls? That's a load of fantasy crap! Grow up!"

One day an email arrives from an untraceable source.

"...Will you hear my story?"

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE124279.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
她们很漂亮。这五位漂亮的女战士英雄将我们的世界从迫在眉睫的黑暗中拯救出来！
然而，很少有人知道那些支持他们存在的人……
这些不起眼的女孩的稀有粉丝创建博客，并试图宣传这些鲜为人知的女主角的日常生活并分享她们的兴趣……
但世界却是无情的。“其他魔法少女？那是一堆幻想废话！快点长大吧！”

有一天，一封电子邮件来自无法追踪的来源。

“……你愿意听听我的故事吗？”

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE124279.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
